portfolio.title: And I'm a AI-Driven Software Developer
portfolio.heroBio: Software developer specializing in React, TypeScript, and full-stack web applications with 4 years of experience building scalable systems.
portfolio.aboutBio1: I’m a AI-Driven Software Engineer with about ~5 years of experience building digital products, scalable applications, and user-focused experiences. My background spans frontend engineering, backend development, and enterprise digital platforms. Today, I’m expanding that foundation into AI engineering exploring LLMs, intelligent systems, and agent-based workflows to build smarter, more capable software.
portfolio.aboutBio2: Tel Aviv, Israel · Available for hybrid or remote roles.

experiences.role: AI Engineer — Agentic Workflows & Frontend Platform
bullets: Accelerated velocity across a 10-developer team by designing AI-native workflows with custom agent rules, MCP toolchains, and context engineering (Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
Evolved internal AI and RAG prototypes from experimental POCs into standardized, repeatable agentic workflows across shared team repositories.
Built 3 platform-wide JS automation libraries (Lead Web Architect approved, adopted by all 10 developers), eliminating analytics and AEM boilerplate across weekly releases (10–55+ peak tickets).
Led GTM, GA4, and Firebase Analytics implementation for a Tier-1 US telecom platform (UScellular / T-Mobile), unifying web and mobile WebView tracking for millions of subscribers.
Shipped custom AEM experiences for flagship Apple, Samsung, and Google launches alongside the T-Mobile rebrand on weekly milestones, while performing regular peer code reviews.
Built Adobe Analytics infrastructure from scratch (20+ events) across e-commerce and Self-Care apps; led bi-weekly client syncs as SME.
Developed frontend OKTA SSO authentication infrastructure across customer-facing e-commerce and self-service applications.
Shipped Drupal CMS modules, feature-flag rollouts, and core e-commerce integrations (credit checks, device protection, Google reCAPTCHA bot mitigation).
Mentored 2 engineers on analytics pipelines (3x team capacity) and enforced standards via peer code reviews.
Owned core frontend delivery for the UK's Ofcom-mandated One Touch Switch system (ThreeUK), serving millions of subscribers.
Shipped shared React/TypeScript (Redux-Saga, MUI) features across web, ARIM retail tablets, and mobile apps.
Delivered broadband compliance, modernized buy-flow features, card-payment add-ons, and cart redesigns (eSIM, number allocation, spend caps).
Provided on-site UK production support across 20+ release handovers, weekend task forces, and debugging guides.
Contributed to storefront migration from React/Contentful to Vue.js, Drupal, and PHP on Acquia with zero disruption.
Rebuilt core checkout, cart management, BYOD, and address validation flows with 100% functional parity.
Delivered configurable CMS storefront modules and buy-flow UI redesigns within a PI-based Agile cadence.
Coordinated feature grooming, spec alignment, and QA validation directly with client stakeholders and Product Owners across two production apps.

recommendations.quote:

I really enjoyed working with Matan and would be happy to work with him again. I highly recommend him and wish him all the best in his next professional challenge.

recommendations.author: Omri Biton
recommendations.quote:
I had the pleasure of working alongside Matan at Amdocs on the Digital UI program for Altice, where we were both frontend developers on the same customer-facing platform.

Matan is a strong full-stack developer with deep frontend skills. He's highly proficient in React, JavaScript and modern UI tooling. What stands out most is his curiosity and drive to keep improving. He's always among the first to explore new technologies, whether that's upgrading our component tooling or adopting AI-assisted development tools early and showing the team how much time they can save. He did all this while pursuing his degree, which says a lot about his discipline and work ethic.

He contributed to successful deliveries, including an Okta integration demo that was well received. He's also a great teammate. He's generous with his knowledge, always ready to discuss an architecture idea or help debug a tricky configuration, and he's honest and practical when giving advice.

Any team would be lucky to have Matan. I highly recommend him.
